definitions.explanation: A comparison or illustration used to explain something.
Used to introduce a hypothetical or concessive condition.

examples.english: Even if it takes time, I want to do it on my own to the end.

notes:
TWO DISTINCT USES:

1. AS A NOUN (example):
- {例|たと}え⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{出|だ}す→出す：01087_dasu⟧ (to give an example)
- {例|たと}え⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{悪|わる}い→悪い：00908_warui⟧ (a bad analogy)
- ⟦{例|たと}えて→例える：10365_tatoeru⟧⟦{言|い}えば→言う：00515_iu⟧ (to use an analogy)

2. AS AN ADVERB (even if):
- {例|たと}え〜て⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧ (even if ~)
- {例|たと}え〜⟦でも→でも：00925_demo⟧ (even though ~)
- Usually written in hiragana: たとえ

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{例|れい}→例：09932_rei⟧ - example (more formal, numbered examples)
- ⟦{比喩|ひゆ}→比喩：13204_hiyu⟧ - metaphor, figure of speech
- ⟦もし→もし：01284_moshi⟧ - if (neutral conditional)
